recovered_doctrine.name: Emergency Narrowness Doctrine
recovered_doctrine.core_meaning: Emergency capability and scope constriction intended to minimize catastrophic or cascading harm, with minimal intervention, human oversight, restricted functions, auditability, and conservative emergency response.
supported_features: minimal intervention / default inaction unless needed for harm prevention
direct mitigation rather than autonomous resolution
dormant or narrow operation when oversight is absent or compromised
cascading narrowing across related risk domains
AI cannot unilaterally end the emergency state
